claim_text: Aristotle distinguishes two kinds of desire.
rationale: Surface English 'desire' matches rich canonical Desire (Greek ὄρεξις) per §3.2 English-form-preferred. The two kinds (βούλησις/wish, ἐπιθυμία/appetite) are implicit per AF5 — passage names both via Ross's interpretation + Aristotle's Greek at 433a23-26 («ἡ γὰρ βούλησις ὄρεξις·...ἡ γὰρ ἐπιθυμία ὄρεξίς τίς ἐστιν»); ἐπιθυμία has ontology node (thin slug), βούλησις does not. Aristotle is attribution-marker per §3.2 attribution-scope-not-referent. Source paragraph contains two genus/species muddles (Papachristou's gloss 'desire (ἐπιθυμία)' treats species-ἐπιθυμία as if it were the genus; Ross's bracketed gloss 'appetite [ὄρεξις]' treats genus-ὄρεξις as if it were the species-appetite); Aristotle's own Greek in the cited footnote 64 disambiguates with ὄρεξις as genus and βούλησις+ἐπιθυμία as species. Labels track Aristotle's-own-Greek reading (Desire = ὄρεξις the genus), not the source's surface gloss confusion.

claim_text: Mind can have no nature of its own except the capacity to receive forms.
rationale: Surface 'Mind' → Thought / Intellect (rich English compound, Greek νοῦς) per §3.0 rich-preferred + most-inclusive-compound (passage shuttles between faculty-sense at 429a10/15 'the part of the soul with which the soul knows / the thinking part of the soul' and activity-sense at 429a13/22 'how thinking can take place / thought... judges'; the dyadic compound captures both); 'nature' → Nature (rich, φύσις) per Aristotelian determinate-nature reading (not Essence/τὸ τί ἦν εἶναι, whatness-as-formula); 'capacity' → Potentiality / Capacity (rich compound, δύναμις) since 'Capacity' in compound name directly matches surface form per §3.2 English-form-preferred; 'forms' → Form (rich, εἶδος) per surface-variant plural→singular convention. §5.4 partial-faithfulness verification: Thought/Intellect, Nature, Potentiality/Capacity grounded in quote at ~429a20-22 ('it can have no nature of its own, other than that of having a certain capacity'); Form is extractor-supplied framing — but the elaboration is unusually tight: 'capable of receiving the form of an object' appears at 429a15-16 (immediately-preceding sentence cluster, same paragraph as quote), and 'the soul "the place of forms"... only potentially, not actually' appears at 429a27-28 (same paragraph, after quote); 'to receive forms' is the ongoing topic of the paragraph and the chapter as a whole. Per §5.4 step 4, charitable-skip applied — labels include Form per paraphrase, no PL:paraphrase-distortion flag. This case sets the within-paragraph-topic-continuation precedent as the tightest end of charitable-skip-eligible elaboration spectrum.
notes: PL:ontology-synonymy — three synonymy cases: (a) Thought/Intellect (rich, νοῦς) + Intellect (rich, νοῦς) + νοῦς (thin) all denote νοῦς-faculty; claim_text 'Mind' has no direct English ontology match (no 'Mind' node); selected Thought/Intellect per §3.0 rich-preferred + most-inclusive-compound (compound captures both faculty-sense and activity-sense the chapter shuttles between). (b) Potentiality/Capacity (rich, δύναμις) + Potentiality (rich, δύναμις) + δύναμις (thin) all denote δύναμις; selected the compound since 'Capacity' in compound name directly matches surface 'capacity' per §3.2 English-form-preferred. (c) Form (rich, εἶδος) + εἶδος (thin); claim_text plural 'forms' → Form (singular) per surface-variant convention. | Observation: §5.4 partial-faithfulness charitable-skip applied — 'to receive forms' is paraphrase-introduced beyond quote ('having a certain capacity') but within-paragraph topic-continuation makes elaboration unusually tight (429a15-16 immediately-preceding 'capable of receiving the form of an object' + 429a27-28 same-paragraph 'the place of forms' continuation + the chapter's ongoing topic). Tightest-end-of-spectrum precedent for item-25 charitable-skip-vs-strict calibration; this case sets the boundary at WITHIN-PARAGRAPH-TOPIC-CONTINUATION as charitable-skip-eligible. claim_text: For a science to be reduced, every predicate appearing in its proper laws must be linked to physical predicates via some bridge law.
rationale: Source location: footnote 4, pdf p. 1-2 of Fodor 1974 — secondary_non_phantasia citation-equivalent. The claim's affirmed referents (Reduction, Bridge law) are absent from the current ontology — modern philosophy-of-science / Fodor-Nagel reduction-theoretic conceptual space is orthogonal to this Aristotle/Heidegger-centered curation horizon (second instance of secondary-author-outside-curation-horizon pattern after dev-3 O'Connor-Wong; counts toward pattern-watch re-evaluation trigger). Per CONVENTIONS §4 AF4 example pattern, expected_ontology_nodes: [] with AF4:Reduction + AF4:Bridge law flags (multi-flag licensed by §4 'or when at least one referent is missing... even if others are present'). 'Predicate' as logical-grammatical category is meta-linguistic; not curated by the current Aristotle/Heidegger ontology (no AF4); status would be re-examined under a formal-logic ontology extension. §5.4 partial-faithfulness applies: claim_text departs from quote in two ways per faithfulness_note. Two distortion mechanisms compose. (1) Terminology shift formula→predicate is a category shift, not synonymy (passage at p.1 distinguishes 'predicates of physics' from 'formulae' built from them: predicate is sub-formula constituent, formula is proposition built from predicates); strict §5.4 step 4 fires on this alone. (2) Specificity addition (no physical)→physical predicates is paper-topic-continuation (Fodor's whole paper is physics-reduction); would be charitable-skip-eligible alone per dev-2 precedent. Composition rule: strictest mechanism governs — mixed-mechanism cases flag when any distortion is non-charitable-skip-eligible. Item-25 calibration data point: without this composition rule, distortion-flag calibration would be unstable (two annotators could disagree on flag-vs-skip based on which distortion they weighted). Top resolver-fuzzy candidates (Cause 0.70, Hypothetical Necessity 0.66, Privation 0.66) are weak embedding-similarity matches with no conceptual fit. faithfulness=partial; no attribution-marker in claim_text (no attribution-scope).
